_note: The one price source (KC-0190, AGENTS §0 r6). Amounts are integers in øre/cent. Approved by Henrik 2026-10-31 (KC-0169). EUR = DKK / 7.46, monthly rounded to the nearest 0.10 EUR, yearly to the nearest whole EUR. Change a price here, then run `npm run stripe:opsaet` (dry run) and `-- --anvend`.

moms._note: KC-0194, gate G6: Henrik is not VAT-registered, so aktiv is false: no VAT is charged or shown anywhere and Stripe Tax is off. varselOere: paid invoices over the trailing 12 months at which the owner gets the 'Momsregistrering nærmer sig' alert (the legal threshold is 50,000 kr). eurKurs: kroner per euro for that sum, the same rate the EUR prices were set with. Once CVR and VAT are registered, set aktiv to true and run `npm run stripe:opsaet` (prices become VAT-inclusive, Stripe Tax on Checkout).

valuta._note: KC-0194: the currency follows the billing country chosen at sign-up (never an IP lookup). Countries named here pay in that currency; every other country pays in 'ellers'.
